// The routes to a source that pass through a self-rebinding alias, the
// default export of an awaited import, an awaited require() or a conditional
// value. A line ending in "// flagged" must be reported; every other line
// must pass.
import * as osNamespace from 'node:os';
// A binding rebound from itself is followed for each path it is read at.
let rebound = process;
rebound = rebound.env;
rebound.HOME; // flagged
let reboundBracket = process;
reboundBracket = reboundBracket['env'];
const { HOME: reboundHome } = reboundBracket; // flagged
let reboundFixture = { env: { HOME: 'fixture-home' } };
reboundFixture = reboundFixture.env;
reboundFixture.HOME;
let reboundArgv = process;
reboundArgv = reboundArgv.argv;
reboundArgv.HOME;
// The default export of a module namespace is the module.
const { default: awaitedDefault } = await import('node:os');
awaitedDefault.homedir(); // flagged
const { default: { homedir: nestedDefault } } = await import('os'); // flagged
(await import('os')).default.homedir(); // flagged
(await import('node:process')).default.env.HOME; // flagged
const { default: { env: { HOME: processDefault } } } = await import('process'); // flagged
osNamespace.default.homedir(); // flagged
(await import('node:os')).default.tmpdir();
const fixtureNamespace = { default: { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' } };
const { default: fixtureDefault } = fixtureNamespace;
fixtureDefault.homedir();
// An awaited require() is the module it requires.
const awaitedRequire = await require('node:os');
awaitedRequire.homedir(); // flagged
(await require('os')).homedir(); // flagged
const { homedir: awaitedHomedir } = await require('node:os'); // flagged
(await require('node:process')).env.HOME; // flagged
// A conditional value may be either branch; a && b is b.
const fixtureOs = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
const fixtureEnv = { HOME: 'fixture-home' };
const maybeOs = useHost ? require('node:os') : fixtureOs;
maybeOs.homedir(); // flagged
const maybeFixtureOs = useHost ? fixtureOs : require('os');
maybeFixtureOs.homedir(); // flagged
const { homedir: chosenHomedir } = useHost ? await import('os') : fixtureOs; // flagged
(useHost ? process : fixtureProcess).env.HOME; // flagged
const eitherEnv = fixtureEnv ?? process.env;
eitherEnv.HOME; // flagged
const orEnv = fixtureEnv || process.env;
orEnv['HOME']; // flagged
const andEnv = useHost && process.env;
andEnv.HOME; // flagged
function readChosen({ HOME } = useHost ? process.env : fixtureEnv) { return HOME; } // flagged
let laterChoice = fixtureOs;
laterChoice = useHost ? osNamespace : fixtureOs;
laterChoice.homedir(); // flagged
const fixtureChoice = useHost ? fixtureOs : { homedir: () => 'other-home' };
fixtureChoice.homedir();
const guardedFixture = process.env && fixtureEnv;
guardedFixture.HOME;
(useHost ? fixtureEnv : process.env).PATH;
// Residual: a value kept in an object literal is not followed.
let reboundOs = { host: require('node:os') };
reboundOs = reboundOs.host;
reboundOs.homedir();
